sentences.text:
The first bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 21.02.2022,
which is reproduced as below:-

"Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the first informant,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in case crime No. 1637 of 2021, under Sections 376, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, P.S. Kotwali Dehat, District Bulandshahr, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
The allegations of kidnapping and rape made against the applicant, are thoroughly false.
In medical examination report, no injury at all has been shown on the body of victim girl.
It has also been submitted that in fact victim girl has already dropped her school in the previous year and thus, there was no occasion for her to collect any form for 10th class.

Learned counsel has further submitted that in fact on 07.09.2021 a quarrel has taken place between applicant and complainant and in the said incident, wife of applicant has sustained injury, copy of her injury report has been annexed as annexure-9 to the bail application.
It was submitted that police did not register the case from the side of applicant and thereafter an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. was moved, which has been allowed.

It was further submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 08.09.2021 and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and cooperate in the trial.

Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the first informant have opposed the prayer for bail and argued that victim is a minor girl, aged 14 years, and that she has made consistent statements under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. that applicant has administered her intoxicated cold drink and committed rape upon her.
It was submitted that there were no satisfactory reasons to falsely implicate the applicant.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusation,
gravity of offence and all attending facts and circumstances of case, the applicant is not entitled to be enlarged on bail.

Hence, the bail application of applicant Anoop Singh @ Annu is hereby rejected."
4.

The second bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 26.09.2023 and Trial Court was directed to expedite the trial and to decide the same preferably within a period of ten months from the date of receipt a copy of this order.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 08.09.2021 and statement of victim and other material witnesses have already been recorded before the Trial Court and thus,
there is no possibility of tampering with evidence.

In the alleged incident, victim has not sustained Anoop Singh @ Annu vs State Of U.P. And 3 Other on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51884147/
2 any injury.

entities.text: Anoop Singh @ Annu vs State Of U.P. And 3 Other
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Applicant has already undergone detention of more than three years and that 17 witnesses have been shown in the charge sheet and thus, trial of the case would take sufficient long time.
Applicant has no criminal history.
It was stated that in case appliant is granted bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and would co-operate in trial.

6. Learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for the informant have opposed the bail application and submitted that the victim is a minor girl aged about 14 years and she has made allegation of rape against the applicant.
However, the aforesaid factual position that applicant is in jail since 08.09.2021 and statement of material witnesses have already been recorded, could not be disputed.
7. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, period of detention and all attending facts, without expressing any opinion on merits, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the present third bail application is hereby allowed.

8. Let the applicant - Anoop Singh @ Annu involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
9. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the trial court shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant in accordance with law.
